name: amarimethod-website
description: Amari Method website with integrated pain assessment quiz

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && node scripts/build-html.js && cp -r css js fonts images videos book favicon* apple-touch-icon.png social-preview.png cos-icon-180.png cos-icon-512.png parking-icon.svg parking-icon-180.png parking-icon-512.png staff-icon.png robots.txt sitemap.xml _redirects llms.txt pricing.md partner-manifest.json staff-manifest.json cos-manifest.json parking-manifest.json staff-sw.js dist/ && npm --prefix quiz-astro ci && npm --prefix quiz-astro run build && rm -rf dist/quiz && mkdir -p dist/quiz && cp -R quiz-astro/dist/. dist/quiz/ && npm --prefix portal ci && npm --prefix portal run build && npm --prefix staff ci && npm --prefix staff run build && npm --prefix cos ci && npm --prefix cos run build && npm --prefix cos run build:parking
scripts.test: vitest run --config functions/api/vitest.config.js --root . functions && vitest run --config series-reconcile-worker/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config daily-audit-worker/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config call-coach-worker/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config reminder-engine-worker/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config nurture-engine-worker/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config crm-mirror-worker/vitest.config.js && node --test morning-sms-worker/src/*.test.js && npm run test:staff-legibility
